result_text:
Contributor lists and the recent-activity bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles, and its one contributor-export test passes. I did not generate a full landscape report to inspect the HTML.

Changes, all in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `limit` variable, the `.limit(...)` call on the sorted contributor stream, and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." paragraph. The sort order is unchanged. This method also builds the bots and teams pages, so they are fixed too.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on `recentContributors` so the bar chart draws one bar per recently active contributor.

I left `contributorsListLimit` in `LandscapeConfiguration` as the task asked. It is now unused by the contributor reports. The repositories report still uses its own limit, which I did not touch. Nothing is committed.
